title: Using network analysis for the prediction of treatment dropout in patients with mood and anxiety disorders: A methodological proof-of-concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - High number of potential predictor variables (‘small n large p’); - Unequal division of patients into completers and dropouts; - Limited number of items for treatment expectation assessment.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability is declared but not explicitly linked to a repository. The study is a proof-of-concept with limited generalizability.
